rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something difficult or complicated to deal with.

example.english: The details in this document are really tricky to deal with.
example.traditional: 呢份文件啲細節真係好難搞。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 man4 gin6 di1 sai3 zit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau2

rows.note: Use this for a person who is sly or deceptive, especially when describing a dubious salesperson.

example.english: That salesperson is tricky and always tricks people into buying useless things.
example.traditional: 嗰個推銷員好古惑，成日呃人買啲冇用嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 hou2 gu2 waak6 seng4 jat6 ngaak1 jan4 maai5 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5
